narrative: 一个碎片不断重复。一张脸、一条肢体、一盏灯变成了装饰纹样。
巴斯比·伯克利（Busby Berkeley）用舞者和俯拍摄影机搭建出这种效果；万花筒转接镜则用镜头前的镜子来实现同样的效果。
合唱女郎、珠宝、一次主观意识的断裂：画面是增殖，而不是涂抹。当图案本身就是重点时使用它：一段歌舞场面、一间珠宝盒般的内景、一张脸的装饰性碎裂。
对于条纹汇聚的星际之门效果、不重复的简单俯拍，或者撕碎边缘的拼贴画来说，这就用错了工具。如果没有镜像逻辑、没有放射状重复，那只是一个杂乱的画面。
how: 实体做法：在镜头前加装万花筒棱镜或三镜筒装置，或者搭建镜面布景；调度上，从鸟瞰（Bird's-Eye View）角度拍摄放射状的编排。
保持清晰的对称轴和重复的碎片。提示词：kaleidoscopic fragmentation, mirrored shards, radial repeat of [Subject], not slit-scan streaks。
when: 一个穿红裙的人物被镜像碎片增殖成珠宝般的对称图案，就像望进一个玩具万花筒。不要把她沿着一条消失点隧道拉伸，然后称之为万花筒。
vs: 狭缝扫描（Slit-Scan）把时间涂抹进一条走廊；万花筒则用镜子重复空间。
重复与图案（Repetition and Pattern）是普通照片中的构图性重复（窗户、士兵）；万花筒是光学或调度出的放射状增殖。
鸟瞰（Bird's-Eye View）是伯克利使用的俯拍角度；如果没有镜像或放射状设计，那只是一个俯视镜头。
examples_film: 巴斯比·伯克利的歌舞场面（《第42街》[42nd Street]、《1933年淘金女郎》[Gold Diggers of 1933]）从高处把合唱女郎变成万花筒式的几何图形；《2001太空漫游》（2001: A Space Odyssey）在“星际之门”的段落中也使用了放射状、珠宝般的碎裂效果，这是镜像效果的表亲，而不仅仅是狭缝扫描。
mistakes: 错误的近亲：狭缝扫描、没有重复的俯拍，或拼贴画。破绽：条纹汇向一个消失点、单纯的俯视，或撕碎的纸张图层。
解决办法：清晰的镜像轴、同一主体的重复碎片、珠宝般的对称。

faq.q: 电影中的万花筒是什么？
faq.a: 通过镜子或放射状调度让一个主体增殖成对称图案的画面。这是空间中的重复，而不是时间上的涂抹。

faq.q: 万花筒 vs 狭缝扫描
faq.a: 狭缝扫描通过一条缝隙随时间累积成条纹；万花筒则围绕一个轴反射一个碎片。一个是走廊，一个是珠宝。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用万花筒？
faq.a: 用于装饰性效果、歌舞几何图形，或镜像化的主观段落。当你需要的是结构化的光隧道或纪录片式俯拍时，不要用它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写万花筒的提示词？
faq.a: 要求镜像碎片、放射状对称，以及一个不断重复的主体；除非要单独呈现，否则禁止狭缝扫描式的走廊效果和撕碎拼贴的边缘。

narrative: A shard repeats. A face, a limb, a lamp becomes an ornament.
Busby Berkeley built this with dancers and an overhead camera. A kaleidoscope adapter builds it with mirrors in front of the lens.
Chorus girls, jewels, a subjective break: the picture is multiplication, not smear. Use it when pattern is the point: a musical number, a jewel-box interior, a decorative fracture of a face.
It is the wrong tool for a stargate of streaks, for a simple birds-eye that does not repeat, or for a collage of torn edges. If there is no mirror logic and no radial repeat, it is just a busy frame.
how: Physical: kaleidoscope prism or three-mirror tube on the lens, or a mirrored set. Staging: radial choreography shot from Bird's-Eye View.
Keep a clear axis of symmetry and repeating shards. Prompt: kaleidoscopic fragmentation, mirrored shards, radial repeat of [Subject], not slit-scan streaks.
when: A figure in a red dress multiplied into mirrored shards, jewel symmetry, like looking into a toy kaleidoscope. Do not stretch her along a vanishing-point tunnel and call it kaleidoscope.
vs: Slit-Scan smears time into a corridor. Kaleidoscope repeats space with mirrors.
Repetition and Pattern is compositional repeat in a normal photograph (windows, soldiers). Kaleidoscope is optical or staged radial multiplication.
Bird's-Eye View is the overhead angle Berkeley used. Without mirroring or radial design it is only a top view.
examples_film: Busby Berkeley numbers (42nd Street, Gold Diggers of 1933) turn chorus girls into kaleidoscopic geometry from above. 2001: A Space Odyssey also uses radial, jewel-like fragmentation in passages of the Star Gate, which is a cousin of the mirror, not the slit alone.
mistakes: Wrong cousin: slit-scan, birds-eye without repeat, or collage. Tell: streaks to a vanishing point, a plain overhead, or torn paper layers.
Fix: clear mirror axes, repeating fragments of the same subject, jewel symmetry.

faq.a: An image multiplied by mirrors or by radial staging so one subject becomes a symmetric pattern. It is repetition in space, not a time smear.
Slit-scan accumulates through a slit over time into streaks. Kaleidoscope reflects a fragment around an axis. Corridor versus jewel.
For ornament, musical geometry, or a mirrored subjective beat. Do not use it when you need a structured light tunnel or a documentary overhead.

faq.q: How do I prompt kaleidoscope for AI image or video?
faq.a: Ask for mirrored shards, radial symmetry, and a repeating subject. Forbid slit-scan corridors and torn-collage edges unless those are separate.
